mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We currently have clear skies and 47 degrees over Reddan Soccer Park, with the Third Quarter moon lighting up the night. Expect a chilly overnight low of 44 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city news, Mayor Diaz has proclaimed October as Community Planning Month to recognize the hard work of our Planning and Development Department. Additionally, the Verona Senior Center is promoting its free tri-shaw Bike Program, which offers electric-assist community rides on the Military Ridge State Trail on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays.

There is a busy weekend ahead! Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Lake Lou-ee. Then on Sunday, October 4, don't miss the World Dairy Expo at the Alliant Energy Center and the Farley Center Fall Festival featuring apple cider pressing.

Looking at our weekly police recap, on Thursday, September 24, officers responded to a collision between a car and an 11-year-old bicyclist at Westward and Jenna Drive. Thankfully, after an assessment by EMS, the child did not need to go to the hospital.
Culver's is currently closed for the night. You can look forward to grabbing tomorrow's Flavor of the Day, Really Reese's, when they open tomorrow morning at 10 AM.
